title: GOOD: Saturating arithmetic prevents integer overflow attacks
description:
Location: rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs lines 116, 175, 417, 465, 478

The code consistently uses saturating_add for rank calculations, preventing integer overflow:
- Line 116: lowest_rank.saturating_add(max_rank_increase)
- Line 175: self.rank.saturating_add(link_cost as u16)
- Line 417: self.lowest_rank.saturating_add(self.max_rank_increase)
- Line 465: cur_cost.saturating_sub(threshold)
- Line 478: chosen_cost comparison

This is correct for a routing protocol where overflowing rank values could create routing loops or security vulnerabilities. Worth defending if someone suggests changing to unchecked arithmetic.
